name: FAOSTAT Crops and Livestock Products Database (QCL)
description: The FAOSTAT Crops and Livestock Products database (Domain QCL) is the canonical global statistical repository curated by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO). Tracking agricultural production, area harvested, and yields for 278 individual crop and livestock commodities across 245+ countries and territories from 1961 to the present, QCL provides harmonized international data on cereals, pulses, fruits, vegetables, livestock populations, dairy, meat, and processed commodities to underpin global food security and economic policy research.
